heard: A secret radioactive clock is bolted to the side of Voyager. In 1977, two robotic spacecraft launched into the great void carrying golden phonograph records designed to tell Earth's complete story to the stars. Inside are spoken greetings in 55 different human languages, whale songs, and human brainwaves recorded during a deeply emotional moment of falling in love. But the protective aluminum cover itself holds an ultra-pure sample of heavy uranium-238. Because this exact isotope decays with a half-life of approximately 4.5 billion years, any finder can calculate the exact time since launch. That brilliant atomic clock is built right into the side of Voyager.
